Condition : 3 - Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form, Design and Access Statement and product specification sheets referenced in Condition 2 unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No Use of Flat Roof  - Access to the flat roof of the development hereby permitted shall be for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.

Condition : 5 - INFORMATIVE
